basic_info.description: Dreamy and bright, this beach lover's retreat is a rare find in San Francisco. Located just blocks to Ocean Beach, this storybook two-bedroom, one-bath home blends charming period details with modern updates, offering turn-key living with an opportunity for growth. The main level features gleaming hardwood floors, two spacious west-facing bedrooms with picturesque ocean views, a generous living room, an eat-in kitchen, and a full bath that captures the charm of the home's original character. The lower level offers expansion potential, featuring a one-car garage, laundry area, workbench, abundant storage space, and an area ideal for an office or home gym. Updated 200AMP Electrical Panel with EV Charger.  Other highlights include a sunny and deep landscaped lot, ideal for gardeners, outdoor diners or those who want to soak up some sunshine. Located in the heart of the popular Outer Sunset neighborhood, this home offers a balance of coastal tranquility and city conveniences. Surfers and beach goers will love the close proximity to Ocean Beach, and urban dwellers will love the thriving local scene filled with cafes, shops and restaurants. Easy access to public transportation (Muni) and major routes, providing a convenient commute to downtown San Francisco or nearby tech hubs.
